item.title: Statement from Vaccinate Your Family on CDC’s Updated Childhood Immunization Schedule - Vaccinate Your Family
item.description: On Monday, January 5, 2026, federal health officials announced changes to the U.S. childhood immunization schedule. As part of this update, the new schedule recategorized some recommended vaccines as now being recommended only for high-risk groups or under “shared clinical decision-making" (SCDM).
